name: cru_macho
desc: Make the crocodile far more muscular and massive: huge bulging biceps and forearms on the outstretched arms, a broad thick chest with big pecs, wide shoulders and traps, veins, like an extreme bodybuilder. Keep the cross pose with arms straight out, the toothy sneer, the melted paint puddle base, and keep the small black cat pinned on its chest exactly the same.
